name: AH-7921
summary: Opioid analgesic that is selective for the μ-opioid receptor. It has around 80% the potency of Morphine when taken orally.

pharmacology.text: AH-7921 (Doxylam) is an opioid analgesic drug selective for the μ-opioid receptor, having around 90% the potency of morphine when administered orally.

uses.text: Although AH-7921 was extensively studied in vitro and in animals, though not in humans, by the developing company, it was never sold commercially for medical use. In 2013, AH-7921 was discovered to have been used as an active ingredient in "synthetic cannabis" products in Japan. In October 2015, two horses (Bossmon and Literata) trained by owner-trainer Roy Sedlacek tested positive for AH-7921 at Belmont Park racetrack.
uses.routes: Recreational: insufflation, sublingual, intravenous, oral, rectal

sideEffects.en: It has barely been studied in people. Reported effects match other strong opioids: drowsiness, nausea, constipation, itching and slowed breathing. It has been linked to deaths, and like other strong opioids it can cause fatal breathing depression and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它幾乎沒有在人體中研究過。已知的反應與其他強效鴉片類藥物相同：嗜睡、噁心、便祕、搔癢與呼吸變慢。它曾與死亡案例有關，和其他強效鴉片類一樣，可能造成致命的呼吸抑制與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它几乎没有在人体中研究过。已知的反应与其他强效鸦片类药物相同：嗜睡、恶心、便秘、搔痒与呼吸变慢。它曾与死亡案例有关，和其他强效鸦片类一样，可能造成致命的呼吸抑制与成瘾。

fact.en: AH-7921 was made in the 1970s by the British drug company Allen and Hanburys, which is where the "AH" in its name comes from. It was never sold as a medicine and resurfaced as a designer drug around 2012.
fact.zh: AH-7921 是英國藥廠 Allen and Hanburys 在 1970 年代合成的，名稱中的「AH」就是取自這家公司。它從未成為上市藥物，約在 2012 年以設計師藥物的身分重新出現。
fact.zhHans: AH-7921 是英国药厂 Allen and Hanburys 在 1970 年代合成的，名称中的「AH」就是取自这家公司。它从未成为上市药物，约在 2012 年以设计师药物的身分重新出现。
